title: Action on a setup configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k$ work tapes, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and fix an input word $x$ over the schedule alphabet. Given a base configuration $c$ on $x$, phases $q,q'$, an input-head position $p\in\{0,\ldots,|x|+1\}$, head positions $b,u,g\in\mathbb{Z}$, and tape contents $\beta,\mu,\gamma\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\text{schedule alphabet})$, apply an action with next phase $q'$, input-head move $d\in\{-1,0,+1\}$, and write–move instructions $(w_b,m_b),(w_u,m_u),(w_g,m_g)$ on the three controller tapes. The result is the setup configuration with phase $q'$, input-head position obtained by moving $p$ by $d$ with clamping to $\{0,\ldots,|x|+1\}$, controller heads at $b+m_b,u+m_u,g+m_g$, and controller tapes updated at their respective old head positions according to the optional writes; its first $k$ work tapes, their head positions, and its output agree with $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$x$ is a list of schedule symbols
$p$ is an input-head position in the range of $x$
each controller instruction consists of an optional write and a movement sign
replaced:
Consider a setup configuration of the oblivious schedule machine built from a Boolean
machine $W$ with $k$ work tapes and padding parameter $a$, with input head at $p$ and
controller tapes $\beta, \mu, \gamma$ with heads at $b, u, g$.  Applying a schedule
action with next phase $q'$, input-head move $d \in \{-1,0,+1\}$, and one (optional
write, move) pair for each controller tape yields exactly the setup configuration with
phase $q'$, input head moved by $d$ (clamped to $\{0,\dots,|x|+1\}$), each controller
tape updated by its optional write at the old head position, and each controller head
shifted by its move; the first $k$ work tapes and the output are untouched.
